In tool orchestration, a batch is defined as one model response containing multiple tool calls. All tool calls in the batch must be stored before executing their results, and user input should only begin after the batch has a result for each call. awaitUser is a property of ToolResult, not a special tool name. Pending questions should be accumulated across the batch, and the outer model loop should be exited only after all sibling calls finish. A later ordinary result must not erase an earlier awaitUser decision.
